sql: WITH m AS (SELECT split_part(ticker,'-',1) AS series, ticker, close_time FROM markets WHERE split_part(ticker,'-',1) IN ('KXGENERALCOUNTY','KXSTATEBALLOTMEASURE','KXAAAGASM','KXWAAEROEMP','KXCABALLOTMEASURES','KXWATECHEMP','KXNYNJPORTTEU','KXNYCASKRENT','KXFLVISITORCOUNT','KXILNUCLEAR','KXTXERCOTPEAK','KXWALLSTBONUS','KXCABUILDPERMITS','KXPAMFGEMP')), p AS (SELECT split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) AS series, count(*) AS n FROM paper_trades WHERE split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) IN (SELECT DISTINCT series FROM m) GROUP BY 1) SELECT m.series, count(*) AS markets, count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.close_time < now()) AS closed, count(DISTINCT split_part(m.ticker,'-',2)) FILTER (WHERE m.close_time < now()) AS closed_events, min(m.close_time)::date AS first_close, max(coalesce(p.n,0)) AS paper_trades FROM m LEFT JOIN p ON p.series = m.series GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC
